name: Summary
rows: DRAFT FOR THE CPA · audit procedures · not an audit report · no opinion expressed
1. Findings Map lists every figure in the draft memo and the cell that calculates it.
2. Click an amount to follow its formulas to the document cell it came from.
3. Each procedure tab shows what was done to each line, with a tickmark.
4. Evidence tabs keep the original cells and each document's text and pages. Original files are attached inside the memo PDF.
◆ Confirmed by the customer, straight to the audit team
✗ Exception: the records disagree with the books
○ Open: a person or the CPA decides
